info.name: OpenRegister Lifecycle Graph Side Moves API
info.description:
A graph lifecycle with a closing form, side moves and a reopen, asserted over HTTP (change lifecycle-over-reference-field, task 3.2; scenarios of specs/object-lifecycle/spec.md).

A case schema derives its moves from three status type objects (Ontvangen, In behandeling, Afgehandeld) under one case type. The administrator owns the case, so the two accounts that act on it hold only what the schema grants: a handler (read, update) and a manager (also manage). Every request carries its own basic auth and sends no cookies.

WHAT IT ASSERTS: the handler is offered the forward move (with the closing form) and suspend; suspend sets the second field and keeps the status; a suspended case offers resume only and refuses the graph move with 422; closing without the required result is refused with 422 naming it; closing with a result is one save and one audit entry listing both; on the closed case the handler is offered nothing and the manager is offered reopen; the reopen moves to the first status and its audit entry is marked as a reopen and names the manager.

Why Newman and not tests/e2e/api-direct (where the task text puts it): playwright.config.ts excludes api-direct from every project, so a spec there would never run (gate-19: API-direct goes to Newman). Under tests/integration so gate-112 (newman-reach) counts it as one CI runs.

exec: pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'OCS-APIRequest', value: 'true' });
// Two accounts that are not administrators: a handler (read, update) and a manager (also manage).
// The administrator owns the case, so neither of them holds an owner's rights over it.
const suffix = Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
pm.collectionVariables.set('suffix', suffix);
pm.collectionVariables.set('handlersGroup', 'or-lc-handlers-' + suffix);
pm.collectionVariables.set('managersGroup', 'or-lc-managers-' + suffix);
pm.collectionVariables.set('handlerId', 'or-lc-handler-' + suffix);
pm.collectionVariables.set('managerId', 'or-lc-manager-' + suffix);
pm.collectionVariables.set('caseType', 'or-lc-casetype-' + suffix);
pm.collectionVariables.set('userPassword', 'Lc!' + suffix + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + 'Zq9');
pm.test('the handlers group is created', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
pm.test('the managers group is created', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
pm.test('the handler account is created', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
pm.test('the manager account is created', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
pm.test('the status type schema is created', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.be.within(200, 299));
pm.collectionVariables.set('statusSchemaId', pm.response.json().id);

item.name: setUp: the case schema, a graph lifecycle with a closing form, side moves and a reopen

exec: pm.test('the case schema is created', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.be.within(200, 299));
pm.collectionVariables.set('caseSchemaId', pm.response.json().id);
pm.test('the register is created', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.be.within(200, 299));
pm.collectionVariables.set('registerId', pm.response.json().id);
pm.test('status type Ontvangen is created', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.be.within(200, 299));
const o = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('s1', o.id || o['@self'].id);
pm.test('status type In behandeling is created', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.be.within(200, 299));
const o = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('s2', o.id || o['@self'].id);
pm.test('status type Afgehandeld is created', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.be.within(200, 299));
const o = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('s3', o.id || o['@self'].id);

item.name: setUp: a case in behandeling, owned by the administrator

exec: pm.test('the case is created', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.be.within(200, 299));
const o = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('caseId', o.id || o['@self'].id);

item.name: The handler is offered the forward move with its form, and suspend

exec: pm.test('the actions are listed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
const actions = pm.response.json().actions.map(a => a.action);
pm.test('the forward move to Afgehandeld and suspend are offered, and nothing else', () => pm.expect(actions).to.have.members(['move-to-' + pm.collectionVariables.get('s3'), 'suspend']));
const close = pm.response.json().actions.find(a => a.action === 'move-to-' + pm.collectionVariables.get('s3'));
pm.test('the move to the terminal status carries the closing form', () => pm.expect(close.form).to.eql({ properties: ['result', 'comment'], required: ['result'] }));
pm.test('suspend is applied', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
const o = pm.response.json();
pm.test('suspended is set', () => pm.expect(o.suspended).to.eql(true));
pm.test('the status stays in behandeling', () => pm.expect(o.status).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('s2')));

item.name: A suspended case offers resume only

exec: pm.test('the actions are listed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
const actions = pm.response.json().actions.map(a => a.action);
pm.test('only resume is offered: the graph moves are gone', () => pm.expect(actions).to.eql(['resume']));

item.name: A graph move is refused while the case is suspended

exec: pm.test('the move is refused with 422', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(422));
pm.test('the refusal says the move is not allowed now', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.include('not allowed from the current state'));

item.name: The status did not move while suspended

exec: pm.test('the case is read', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
const o = pm.response.json();
pm.test('still in behandeling and still suspended', () => { pm.expect(o.status).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('s2')); pm.expect(o.suspended).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('resume is applied', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
const o = pm.response.json();
pm.test('suspended is cleared', () => pm.expect(o.suspended).to.eql(false));

item.name: Closing without the required result is refused

exec: pm.test('the move is refused with 422', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(422));
pm.test('the refusal names result', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.include('"result"'));

item.name: The handler closes the case with a result

exec: pm.test('the move is applied', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
const o = pm.response.json();
pm.test('the case is closed', () => pm.expect(o.status).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('s3')));
pm.test('the result is saved with the move', () => pm.expect(o.result).to.eql('granted'));

item.name: One audit entry lists both the status and the result

exec: pm.test('the audit trail is read', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
const s3 = pm.collectionVariables.get('s3');
const closing = pm.response.json().results.filter(r => r.changed && r.changed.status && r.changed.status.new === s3);
pm.test('exactly one entry records the move to Afgehandeld', () => pm.expect(closing.length).to.eql(1));
pm.test('that entry also records the result', () => pm.expect(closing[0].changed.result).to.eql({ old: null, new: 'granted' }));

item.name: A handler without manage is offered nothing on the closed case

exec: pm.test('the actions are listed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
const actions = pm.response.json().actions.map(a => a.action);
pm.test('no action, reopen included', () => pm.expect(actions).to.eql([]));

item.name: A manager is offered reopen on the closed case

exec: pm.test('the actions are listed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
const actions = pm.response.json().actions.map(a => a.action);
pm.test('reopen is the only action', () => pm.expect(actions).to.eql(['reopen']));
pm.test('reopen is applied', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
const o = pm.response.json();
pm.test('the case is back at the first status', () => pm.expect(o.status).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('s1')));

item.name: The reopen is audited as a reopen

exec: pm.test('the audit trail is read', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
const s1 = pm.collectionVariables.get('s1');
const reopen = pm.response.json().results.filter(r => r.changed && r.changed.status && r.changed.status.new === s1);
pm.test('one entry records the move back to Ontvangen', () => pm.expect(reopen.length).to.eql(1));
pm.test('it is marked as a reopen', () => pm.expect(reopen[0].changed.transitionKind).to.eql('reopen'));
pm.test('it names the manager', () => pm.expect(reopen[0].user).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('managerId')));
pm.test('the case is removed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.be.within(200, 299));
pm.test('status type Ontvangen is removed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.be.within(200, 299));
pm.test('status type In behandeling is removed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.be.within(200, 299));
pm.test('status type Afgehandeld is removed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.be.within(200, 299));
pm.test('the register is removed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.be.within(200, 299));
pm.test('the case schema is removed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.be.within(200, 299));
pm.test('the status type schema is removed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.be.within(200, 299));
pm.test('the handler is removed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
pm.test('the manager is removed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
pm.test('the handlers group is removed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
pm.test('the managers group is removed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
